notes: Copy site/ as a unit. All URLs inside are relative, so any mount path works. Every toy reads data from <data-base>, resolved as: ?data-base= query param, else window.REDISTRICTING_DATA_BASE, else ../data/ . Absolute (CDN) bases need CORS (jsDelivr sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *).

override_order: window.REDISTRICTING_DATA_BASE (set before the page script runs)
data_base.cdn_note: Pin <commit-or-tag> to a full commit hash or a tag; branch names are cached by jsDelivr for up to 12 h. The data folder is 39.3 MB (37.5 MiB); the toys only fetch what the visitor opens.

toys.title: Fair Lines: state solver and borderless US
toys.description: Pick a state and get equal-population, contiguous, compact districts; the national view solves all 435 districts across state lines.

files.note: state list and seat counts; fetched at load
51 files (50 states + DC), 0.1 to 2.4 MB each; fetched when a state is opened (PA is 0.88 MB)
fetched when the Borderless US view is opened

iframe.note: desktop layout was captured at 1360x1000; give it at least 640 px of height

toys.csp: Uses one Web Worker built from a Blob (national solve): script-src 'unsafe-inline' (the page is a single file with inline script/style), worker-src blob:, img-src data: (size-function PNG is a data URI), connect-src 'self' plus the CDN origin if used. Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com, fonts.gstatic.com) are optional: without them system fonts are used.
link_url_forms: site/fair-lines/#PA (open a state; any two-letter code)

data_base_config.window_global: <script>window.REDISTRICTING_DATA_BASE = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/domattioli/redistricting@<commit-or-tag>/site/data/";</script> placed before the toy's own script, i.e. only for a toy page you serve yourself; inside an iframe use the query form
data_base_config.default: ../data/ (relative to the toy page, i.e. site/data/)
